verdict.rationale: The evidence documents MailerLite API keys for machine-to-machine authentication, but nothing shows those keys can be scoped, made read-only, or restricted from sending campaigns. A generic API key is an adjacent capability, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
